Independent bounded enumeration recipe: for each n=0..13 and each integer x in [0,2^(n+2)), collect outputs obtained by concatenating (110 >> ((x >> i) & 7)) & 1 for i=n-1 down to 0; count distinct outputs. The numerical check bisected x^2(x-1)^2=x+1 on (1,2).
correctness.rationale: The local table gives the stated two labeled edge sets, and every finite path corresponds to an extendable bilateral input block. Starting from all four vertices yields the listed eight subsets including the empty one; the two proposed identifications have equal transitions on classes, leaving five live states plus the sink. The empty suffix separates the sink; 0 separates E from the other live states, 10 separates D from A/B/C, 010 separates C from A/B, and 1010 separates A/B. Summing labeled paths from A gives the word count, since the presentation is deterministic. Eliminating the five continuation series yields A(z)=(1-z+z^2)/[(1-z)(1-2z+z^2-z^3-z^4)]. The live graph is strongly connected and has a self-loop; its Perron root exceeds one and is the largest root of the quartic, yielding the logarithmic spatial entropy. The independent enumeration of all binary inputs of length n+2 through n=13 gave the stated counts and then 5252, and numerical bisection gave root 1.8971794010653942 and log 0.6403682574172238. Every 010^m10 with m>=1 exits from E to the sink; its immediate prefix ends at E and its immediate suffix at D. Thus its proper factors are allowed, and arbitrarily long minimally forbidden words rule out finite type.
residual_risks: One-step spatial language and spatial shift entropy only. The family is not asserted to exhaust all minimal forbidden words.

evidence: The irreducible sofic image has entropy given by exponential periodic growth. The zeta pole at the reciprocal leading quartic root is not canceled: at a positive zero of 1-2z+z^2-z^3-z^4 the numerator 1-z-z^4 equals z(1-z+z^2)>0. Thus the same-day zeta gives the entropy invariant as well as sharing the growth polynomial.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: That implication establishes overlap on entropy, not on the count of arbitrary extendable words with specified boundaries. Periodic point counts alone do not determine such block counts or named forbidden words. Exponential first-offender growth implies non-SFT, not the explicit patterned witness. The rule-specific compact presentation and exact language enumeration are the surviving contributions.
